scope: DPP Autopilot only; shared Supabase non-dpp_* data is excluded.

export.implementation: M21 dpp_api_export_bundle() owner/admin active-tenant export + optional serverless evidence-byte augmentation

evidence_bytes_precursor.authorization: owner/admin enforced by dpp_api_export_bundle(); caller JWT reused for private dpp-evidence object reads
evidence_bytes_precursor.integrity: byte_size + SHA-256 verified against evidence_manifest before inclusion
evidence_bytes_precursor.failure_mode: fail closed on unavailable object, integrity mismatch, or size limit

export.current_gap: Inline evidence bytes are implemented/tested only as a bounded precursor; exhaustive large-tenant export/package streaming and real authenticated Storage roundtrip/deployed acceptance remain unproven.

retention_rules.notes: staged/validated in-progress imports are never purged by the precursor
audit rows intentionally survive relational cascades; before/after snapshots require an accepted minimization/redaction policy before destructive org deletion

blockers: exhaustive production evidence-byte export/package acceptance not proven
passport/version regulatory retention period not accepted
registry submission retention/external recipient terms not accepted
evidence storage deletion lifecycle not accepted
audit snapshot retention/minimization exception not accepted
auth account deletion workflow not accepted
